messages:
maya: Hey all — planning a short release readiness sync for next Thursday (cut = Thu 2026-05-28). Need to lock attendees and owners. Can people reply with availability and any agenda items to add? :calendar:

alex: I can make the 9:30–10:00 PT slot. Please add DB migration review — that's the blocker for us.

karim: 9:30 PT works. Can we put canary rollout owner check and fallback plan on the agenda?

jin: +1 for 9:30. Also want a minute for metrics thresholds for automatic rollback.

lisa: I might be late by 10m. I'll own smoke test signoff and post-deploy alerts.

maya: Awesome — current proposed agenda: 1) Quick cut confirmation + roles, 2) DB migration checklist (alex), 3) Canary rollout & thresholds (karim/jin), 4) Smoke test & alerts (lisa), 5) Rollback runbook & on-call routing (sam). Anything to add?

karim: Add a short pre-cut dependency call to confirm infra capacity (eng-infra heads).

sam: I'm on for rollback runbook. Also can we add a smoke-telemetry sanity check — small script that validates token-level latencies post-cut?

maya: Good call. Adding "post-cut telemetry sanity script" under smoke.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Release Readiness Sync — Thu 2026-05-28 09:30 PT. Attendees: maya, alex, karim, jin, lisa, sam. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/1970004321

alex: Will paste DB migration commands we'll run in the meeting notes. Simple diff + backup steps.

jin: Quick question — who is the compliance approver for customer-data flags? Need explicit sign-off before cut.

lisa: @maya can confirm. If not me, ops-safety will sign off (I can ping them now).

maya: I'll loop in @rachel (legal/compliance) and ask for a 15m async ack before cut.

sam: For on-call routing: add a direct pager channel and escalation list in the invite.

maya: Done — escalation list field added to the invite. Final ask: please react :thumbsup: if you can attend at 9:30 PT, or reply with an alternative time.

alex: :thumbsup:

karim: :thumbsup:

jin: :thumbsup:

lisa: :thumbsup: (might be +10m late)

sam: :thumbsup:

maya: Great — if any stakeholders are missing, ping me and I'll add. I'll drop the meeting notes template before EOD. Thanks!
